# listmonk_lists (Data Source)

Returns all listmonk lists the API user can see, optionally filtered.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "listmonk_lists" "newsletters" {
  tag  = "newsletter"
  type = "public"
}

output "newsletter_list_ids" {
  value = data.listmonk_lists.newsletters.lists[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tag` (String) Only return lists with this tag.
- `type` (String) Only return lists of this type (`public` or `private`).

### Read-Only

- `lists` (Attributes List) The lists, ordered by ID. `subscriber_count` is always 0 here; use `listmonk_list` for counts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--lists))

<a id="nestedatt--lists"></a>
### Nested Schema for `lists`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the list.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the list.
- `name` (String) Name of the list.
- `optin` (String) `single` or `double`.
- `status` (String) `active` or `archived`.
- `subscriber_count` (Number) Number of subscribers (only filled in by `listmonk_list`).
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags on the list.
- `type` (String) `public` or `private`.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the list.
